details.description: DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct is DeepSeek AI's second-generation open-source code and math model, a 236-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 21 billion active parameters per token, further pre-trained from an intermediate DeepSeek-V2 checkpoint on 6 trillion additional tokens. Released June 2024, it expands the original DeepSeek-Coder's programming-language coverage from 86 to 338 languages and lengthens its context window. DeepSeek's own GitHub repository and paper report it matching or exceeding GPT-4-Turbo, Claude 3 Opus and Gemini 1.5 Pro on several coding and math benchmarks. DeepSeek's current API no longer lists DeepSeek-Coder-V2 as a distinct model.
advantages: Scores 90.2% pass@1 on HumanEval, ahead of GPT-4-Turbo-0409's 88.2%, per DeepSeek's GitHub repository.
Scores 75.7% on MATH, ahead of Claude 3 Opus's reported 60.1%, per DeepSeek's GitHub repository.
Scores 94.9% on GSM8K and 79.2% on MMLU, per DeepSeek's GitHub repository.
Supports 338 programming languages, up from 86 in the original DeepSeek-Coder, per DeepSeek's GitHub repository.
disadvantages: DeepSeek's current API no longer lists DeepSeek-Coder-V2 as a distinct model, so it is available only as open weights or via third-party hosts such as Fireworks.
Scores 43.4% on LiveCodeBench, only matching (not exceeding) GPT-4o-0513's 43.4%, per DeepSeek's GitHub repository.
Fireworks' model page states function calling is not supported.
use_cases: Coding chat assistant / conversational coding agents
Enterprise and tool-integrated retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), per Fireworks' model page

sources.title: DeepSeek-Coder-V2: Breaking the Barrier of Closed-Source Models in Code Intelligence
DeepSeek Coder V2 Instruct - Fireworks AI

notes: DeepSeek's GitHub README states a 128K-token context window and Fireworks' page lists 131,072 tokens, both well above the catalog's max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens of 65536 each; kept the catalog's value and left the specific context figure out of the description/advantages per instructions. No source stated the natural human languages supported (only the 338 programming languages, which is a count so it stays out of the languages list per the brief), so languages is left empty. DeepSeek's current API pricing page (checked 2026-09-24) lists only deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro.
